acknowledgement_proof: Unchanged axi_periph_slave GPU write arm drives the write strobe/data and completes its write response independently of GPU readback. gpu_core has no write acknowledgement output.
limitation:
Recompile the actual GPU in a pinned full integration fixture, palette on/off.

On tests must give identical complete MMIO transcripts to the parent. Off tests
require zero palette readback after reset, writes, soft/ring resets and flushes.
The peripheral bus adapter is unchanged: GPU writes have no return/ack signal.
This test covers the GPU register strobe interface, not a new AXI bridge model.
